name: Costa Mesa Parks and Community Services part-time jobs
what_you_do: Work part time for the city. Community Services Leaders help run youth programs, camps, events and city buildings. Instructor Lifeguards watch the pool and may teach swim lessons. Leaders average 20 hours a week.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 or older. High school students may need a work permit. Lifeguards must get Red Cross lifeguard training within 6 weeks of being hired. Jobs with children need a TB test from the last 2 years.
pay_detail: The city salary page lists $20.00 to $24.31 an hour for Community Services Leaders and Instructor Lifeguards.
duration: Part time, up to about 20 hours a week. Some jobs are seasonal and some are year-round.
deadline_text: The Community Services Leader and Instructor Lifeguard postings are open all the time (continuous). The city calls people as spots open.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the city's job board at governmentjobs.com. Pick Community Services Leader or Instructor Lifeguard, then make an account and apply. If you are picked, the city contacts you in 4 to 6 weeks.
notes: The Apply Here link on the city's own page is broken, so go to the job board directly. The lifeguard posting itself shows $10.00 to $12.16 an hour, which is below the state minimum wage and does not match the city salary page, so ask HR. The Police Cadet job needs you to be 18. The city also runs free teen centers for grades 7 to 12. Paid work under 18 in California needs a work permit. See permit.html?state=ca for the steps.
